resources.string: Runs Rokid Coder controls and guides secure Wireless Debugging pairing during first-run setup.
Rokid Coder controls and secure first-run setup
Type on the glasses from your paired phone. Text is never saved by Rokid Coder.
Waiting for the Rokid Coder phone app
Find “Rokid Coder” in the Settings list and switch it on.\n\nRokid Coder comes straight back here and finishes the rest on its own.
Connect the glasses to Wi-Fi from the Hi Rokid app on your phone.\n\nRokid Coder picks up where it left off the moment they are online.
Automatic setup could not finish here. Open Rokid Coder on your phone and use Manual setup.
%1$s\n\nTap retry — Rokid Coder reopens the secure setup and finishes arming.
Rokid Coder is armed and ready.
Waiting for Rokid Coder to be switched on.
